Type: distressed vintage-style area rug
Use: accent under a console or seating; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: low-pile woven yarn, worn-look finish
Colors: light aqua blue, navy, grey, ivory
Shape: rectangular, faded medallion with ornate border, distressed texture, thin flat profile, compact
Feel: relaxed, timeworn, cool
Goes with: rustic wood, brick, white walls, green plants; farmhouse or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Distressed Vintage Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Blue
product.description: 80% Nylon, 20% Cotton Imported Inspired by timeless design, this rug combines charming vintage, weathered touches with modern low-maintenance materials. Made of natural and synthetic fibers in a rich blue palette, it adds soft texture and lasting style to your décor. Fashionable distressed vintage pattern Tufted in India. Durable for high traffic areas 4' x 6' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
